title: Campfires Need Fuel!
description: Makes it so you need to fuel campfires to keep them alight.
body:
# Campfires Need Fuel! ## What does it do? When you get ahold of a campfire, they will no longer be lit by default.
Instead, they will come with 10 seconds of fuel, once you light them with a flint and steel.
To keep the flame alive longer, you will need to place fuel on the campfire. ## What kind of fuel is there? Many wooden and dry materials, just as general fuels can be used. Different materials add differing amounts of time to the campfires duration. - Short Dry Grass (10 seconds) - Tall Dry Grass (15 Seconds) - Sticks (25 seconds) - Dead Bushes (30 seconds) - Charcoal (45 seconds) - Coal (50 seconds) - Coal Blocks (7 minutes and 30 seconds)
